messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need final changelog snippet + canonical docs links and target rollout time for Friday's announcement. Also planning to call out benchmark highlight and webinar sign-up. Can engineering/docs confirm by EOD? @sam @jess

sam: On it. I have a short changelog ready. Any constraints on length for the marketing blurb?

maria: Keep it tight: 2–3 bullets + one one-line technical note. We'll link to the full changelog in docs.

sam: OK pasting minimal changelog we can use:
```
- Added adaptive batching for v2 runtime (up to 3x throughput on long contexts)
- KV cache persistence option for Private deployments (reduces cold-start latency)
- Model routing policies: region-aware failover + canary rollout flag
```

jess: Docs: canonical links below — please use these exact URLs in the post and CTA buttons:
- https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2-changelog
- https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/private-deployments
- https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/benchmarking

alex: Rollout timing: plan is canary start 14:00 PT Friday, followed by a 2-hour ramp to 100%. Dedicated/SLA customers will be excluded from auto-rollout unless they opt in. Marketing: do you want that phrasing in the public post?

maria: Yes, wording like: "rolling out starting 14:00 PT Friday, expect full ramp ~2 hours; dedicated customers will not be auto-upgraded."

maria: Also need webinar sign-up link and presenter list — can we confirm who will do the 10-min demo + Q&A? We'll slot a quick customer-focused benchmark slide.

sam: I can do the 10-min demo + Q&A. Add me to the deck and I'll prep the demo flow.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for release/v2 at 2025-06-06T21:00:00Z (14:00 PT). Will post status updates in #eng-releases when canary completes.

jess: Quick benchmark blurb suggestion for the post: "Internal benchmarks show ~2.8x throughput improvement on long-context workloads vs v1; see benchmarks page for methodology." Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/v2

maria: Perfect. Final asks: confirm there are no embargo conflicts and legal sign-off. We'll embargo social and blog until the rollout start time. @alex can you confirm legal ok?

alex: Legal and compliance cleared this morning. No embargo exceptions. Public post allowed at rollout start.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll assemble the announcement draft with the snippets/links and ping the thread for final sign-off by 5:00pm PT today.

sam: Sounds good, will be around for last-checks.

jess: I'll upload the updated docs pages and notify when the canonical changelog URL is live.

maria: Awesome — appreciate it! :tada:
